svg.title: Parasol solution map — Service Mesh 3 & Advanced Gateways
svg.desc: The Parasol claims application — web front end, claims API, claims database, fraud, notifications, serverless premium calculator, event broker and consumer, batch jobs and a model endpoint — with the platform capabilities around it, grouped as build, deliver, run, connect, observe, secure and govern, and resilience. Highlighted here: Routes & gateways, Service mesh, parasol-web, parasol-claims, claims-db, parasol-fraud.
svg.text: What the labs deploy and connect
